response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a diverse technical background, but his experience lacks direct alignment with the core requirements of C++ on Windows, SQL Server/Oracle, and capital markets/fixed income domain expertise. His profile is more suited to web/mobile development and general software engineering roles.
strengths: Extensive experience with modern software development practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development).
Strong communication skills and knowledge-sharing mindset (workshops, talks, open-source contributions).
Diverse technical background with exposure to multiple languages and frameworks.
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (last noted in 2015) and no explicit Windows platform development.
No demonstrated experience in capital markets, investment banking, or fixed income domains.
Primary expertise lies in web/mobile development (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js) rather than low-latency or financial systems.
